notes: Platformers: even jumps, stomp, double jump, and Up / Fire / either to jump. Enemies can wait, patrol then chase, and stay in their room. Pro: EXONORIT packs your program and pictures to about half the size, and up to 16 map levels. God mode: infinite lives, enemies can't hurt, F8 skips the level. Leap Froggy updated with new music.
